CorrectiveAction.name: Clean steam tip holes with paper clip
CorrectiveAction.description: Clear blockage from the steam tip holes.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Clean steam tip holes with a paper clip.

CorrectiveAction.name: Remove dried milk from steam tip and teflon tube
CorrectiveAction.description: Unscrew the steam tip and clear dried milk from the steam tip and white teflon tube.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Unscrew the steam tip from the wand. Check the inside of the steam tip for dried up milk and then make sure the white teflon tube in the steam wand is also free of dried up milk.

CorrectiveAction.name: Attach steam knob c-clip
CorrectiveAction.description: Ensure the c-clip is attached on the steam knob assembly.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Remove the end cap on the end of the steam knob. Check to make sure that the c-clip shown in the picture is attached.

CorrectiveAction.name: Attach hot water knob c-clip
CorrectiveAction.description: Ensure the c-clip is attached on the hot water knob assembly.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Remove the end cap on the end of the hot water knob. Check to make sure that the c-clip shown in the picture on the previous page is attached.

CorrectiveAction.name: Restore water supply and power cycle machine
CorrectiveAction.description: Turn water back on and restart the machine.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: If the water was off, then turn the water back on. Turn the power switch off, unplug the machine and then wait 5 seconds and then plug the machine back in and turn the power switch back on.

CorrectiveAction.name: Set PID F.02 to correct mode
CorrectiveAction.description: Set the PID controller F.02 parameter to the proper heating mode.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check the F.02 setting in the PID controller. It should be set to either 7 for 15 amp mode or 5 for 20 amp mode.

CorrectiveAction.name: Press hi-limit reset button
CorrectiveAction.description: Reset the boiler hi-limit by pressing the red reset button.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: With the machine unplugged, firmly press the red reset button shown in the attached pictures.

CorrectiveAction.name: Fill water reservoir with cold softened water
CorrectiveAction.description: Refill the water reservoir to restore operation.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure the water reservoir is filled with cold softened water.

CorrectiveAction.name: Turn machine off and back on to reset
CorrectiveAction.description: Reset the machine by cycling power.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Turn the machine off for 3 seconds and then turn back on to reset.

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace vacuum breaker valve
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the vacuum breaker valve to correct steam discharge or vapor lock behavior.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: If the steam continues to fill the drip tray after a few minutes then the vacuum breaker valve should be replaced.

CorrectiveAction.name: Adjust pump pressure to 9 bar
CorrectiveAction.description: Adjust the pump pressure to the recommended setting.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Activate the brew lever and check the pump pressure. Recommended setting is 9 bar. Adjust pump pressure if necessary.

CorrectiveAction.name: Adjust grind coarser
CorrectiveAction.description: Adjust the coffee grind coarser to improve slow or blocked flow.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: If pump pressure is good then try adjusting grind coarser.

CorrectiveAction.name: Reduce coffee fill and tamping pressure
CorrectiveAction.description: Avoid overfilling the basket and tamping above 30 lbs.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Be sure the insert basket is not over filled with coffee and you are tamping with no more than 30lbs of pressure.

CorrectiveAction.name: Adjust grind finer
CorrectiveAction.description: Adjust the coffee grind finer to slow fast espresso flow.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: If pump pressure is good then try adjusting grind finer.

CorrectiveAction.name: Use proper coffee amount and 30lbs tamping
CorrectiveAction.description: Fill the basket properly and tamp with 30 lbs of pressure.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Be sure the insert basket is filled with the proper amount of coffee and you are tamping with 30lbs of pressure.

CorrectiveAction.name: Lock portafilter fully right
CorrectiveAction.description: Lock the portafilter tightly into the grouphead.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure portafilter is tightly locked into the grouphead as far right as it can go.

CorrectiveAction.name: Reduce coffee fill in portafilter basket
CorrectiveAction.description: Avoid overfilling the portafilter basket.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure the portafilter basket is not over filled with coffee.

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace group gasket
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the group gasket if it is more than a year old.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Replace the group gasket if more than a year old.

CorrectiveAction.name: Check temperature sensor, heater connections, and reset for coffee boiler
CorrectiveAction.description: Correct the A1 alarm by checking the coffee boiler sensing and heater connections and resetting.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check temperature sensor, heater connections, and reset for coffee boiler.

CorrectiveAction.name: Check for damaged temperature sensor in coffee boiler
CorrectiveAction.description: Correct the A2 alarm by checking the coffee boiler temperature sensor.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check for damaged temperature sensor in coffee boiler.

CorrectiveAction.name: Check temperature sensor, heater connections, and reset for steam boiler
CorrectiveAction.description: Correct the A3 alarm by checking the steam boiler sensing and heater connections and resetting.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check temperature sensor, heater connections, and reset for steam boiler.

CorrectiveAction.name: Check for damaged temperature sensor in steam boiler
CorrectiveAction.description: Correct the A4 alarm by checking the steam boiler temperature sensor.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check for damaged temperature sensor in steam boiler.

CorrectiveAction.name: Check PID programming and reset to default settings
CorrectiveAction.description: Correct the A5 or A6 alarm by checking PID programming and resetting defaults.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check PID programming, reset to default settings.
